# Random HTML Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Shadow Sprint

**Concept:**
- The player controls a small square that constantly moves forward across an endless scrolling canvas.
- Randomly generated "shadow" obstacles appear from the right and move left.
- The player can tap or press a key to briefly jump over obstacles.

**Lose Condition:**
- The game ends when the player's square collides with a shadow obstacle.

**Goal:**
- Survive as long as possible, with the score increasing over time.

1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: if (!canvas) {
6:   throw new Error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
7: }
8: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9: // Load sound effects (data URLs for simplicity)
10: const jumpSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'); // short beep
11: const gameOverSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA'); // short beep
12: const WIDTH = canvas.width;
13: const HEIGHT = canvas.height;
14: 
15: // Player configuration
16: const player = {
17:   x: 50,
18:   size: 20,
19:   // ground position (bottom of canvas minus player size)
20:   groundY: HEIGHT - 20,
21:   y: HEIGHT - 20,
22:   vy: 0,
23:   gravity: 0.6,
24:   jumpStrength: -12,
25:   isJumping: false,
26: };
27: 
28: // Obstacle configuration
29: const obstacles = [];
30: const obstacleSpeed = 4;
31: let obstacleTimer = 0;
32: const obstacleInterval = 1500; // ms
33: 
34: let score = 0;
35: let lastTimestamp = 0;
36: let gameOver = false;
37: 
38: function spawnObstacle() {
39:   const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30; // random width/height
40:   obstacles.push({
41:     x: WIDTH,
42:     y: HEIGHT - size,
43:     width: size,
44:     height: size,
45:   });
46: }
47: 
48: function resetGame() {
49:   player.y = player.groundY;
50:   player.vy = 0;
51:   player.isJumping = false;
52:   obstacles.length = 0;
53:   obstacleTimer = 0;
54:   score = 0;
55:   gameOver = false;
56:   lastTimestamp = performance.now();
57:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
58: }
59: 
60: function handleJump() {
61:   if (!player.isJumping) {
62:     player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
63:     player.isJumping = true;
64:     // play jump sound
65:     if (jumpSound && typeof jumpSound.play === 'function') {
66:       jumpSound.currentTime = 0;
67:       jumpSound.play();
68:     }
69:   }
70: }
71: 
72: // Input: spacebar or mouse click/tap
73: window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
74:   if (e.code === 'Space') handleJump();
75: });
76: canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', handleJump);
77: canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
78:   e.preventDefault();
79:   handleJump();
80: });
81: 
82: function update(delta) {
83:   // Player physics
84:   player.vy += player.gravity;
85:   player.y += player.vy;
86:   if (player.y >= player.groundY) {
87:     player.y = player.groundY;
88:     player.vy = 0;
89:     player.isJumping = false;
90:   }
91: 
92:   // Obstacles movement
93:   for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
94:     const obs = obstacles[i];
95:     obs.x -= obstacleSpeed;
96:     // Remove off‑screen obstacles
97:     if (obs.x + obs.width < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
98:   }
99: 
100:   // Spawn new obstacles
101:   obstacleTimer += delta;
102:   if (obstacleTimer > obstacleInterval) {
103:     spawnObstacle();
104:     obstacleTimer = 0;
105:   }
106: 
107:   // Collision detection (AABB)
108:   for (const obs of obstacles) {
109:       if (
110:         player.x < obs.x + obs.width &&
111:         player.x + player.size > obs.x &&
112:         player.y < obs.y + obs.height &&
113:         player.y + player.size > obs.y
114:       ) {
115:         gameOver = true;
116:         // play game over sound
117:         if (gameOverSound && typeof gameOverSound.play === 'function') {
118:           gameOverSound.currentTime = 0;
119:           gameOverSound.play();
120:         }
121:         break;
122:       }
123:   }
124: 
125:   // Score increases with time
126:   score += delta / 1000;
127: }
128: 
129: function draw() {
130:   // Background gradient (sky to ground)
131:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
132:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light sky blue
133:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#f0e68c'); // light ground yellow
134:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
135:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
136: 
137:   // Ground line
138:   ctx.strokeStyle = '#654321';
139:   ctx.lineWidth = 4;
140:   ctx.beginPath();
141:   ctx.moveTo(0, player.groundY + player.size);
142:   ctx.lineTo(WIDTH, player.groundY + player.size);
143:   ctx.stroke();
144: 
145:   // Draw player (rounded square with gradient)
146:   const playerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y, 0, player.y + player.size);
147:   playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4500'); // orange-red top
148:   playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8c00'); // orange bottom
149:   ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
150:   const radius = 4;
151:   ctx.beginPath();
152:   ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, player.y);
153:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size - radius, player.y);
154:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.size, player.y, player.x + player.size, player.y + radius);
155:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size - radius);
156:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size, player.x + player.size - radius, player.y + player.size);
157:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + player.size);
158:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + player.size, player.x, player.y + player.size - radius);
159:   ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + radius);
160:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + radius, player.y);
161:   ctx.closePath();
162:   ctx.fill();
163: 
164:   // Draw obstacles (shadowed rectangles with gradient)
165:   for (const obs of obstacles) {
166:     // shadow
167:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
168:     ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 3, obs.y + 3, obs.width, obs.height);
169:     // obstacle gradient
170:     const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, obs.y, 0, obs.y + obs.height);
171:     obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#808080');
172:     obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#a9a9a9');
173:     ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
174:     ctx.fillRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.width, obs.height);
175:   }
176: 
177:   // Draw score
178:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
179:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
180:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
181: 
182:   if (gameOver) {
183:     // Dark overlay
184:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
185:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
186:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
187:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
188:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
189:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 10);
190:     ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + Math.floor(score), WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
191:     ctx.textAlign = 'start';
192:   }
193: }
194: 
195: function loop(timestamp) {
196:   const delta = timestamp - lastTimestamp;
197:   lastTimestamp = timestamp;
198:   if (!gameOver) {
199:     update(delta);
200:     draw();
201:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202:   } else {
203:     draw(); // draw final frame with overlay
204:   }
205: }
206: 
207: // Start the game
208: resetGame();

(End of file - total 208 lines)
</content>
